critic_risk_flags: Observation-target alignment is potentially problematic: observing H (a stock/compartment level) is not the same as weekly hospitalization admissions/rate unless the model’s H state is explicitly defined as an admission flow proxy. Additionally, adding an H compartment increases complexity and is specifically flagged as weakly identifiable for short single-season series; delayed_I is more plausible here given the surveillance semantics and limited data length.
